title: The White Elephant Of Tel Aviv

sentences.en: By all accounts, if you've ever taken a bus to or from Tel Aviv's new central bus station,
sentences.zh: 据各方说法，如果你曾经乘巴士往返于特拉维夫的新中央巴士站，
你绝对不会忘记那段经历。

sentences.en: It's one of the most bizarre and magical and disgusting and enchanting places you can imagine.
sentences.zh: 那是你所能想象到的最怪异、最神奇、最恶心、也最迷人的地方之一。

sentences.en: This is Mishy Harmon of the radio show and podcast Israel Story,
sentences.zh: 这是广播节目和播客《以色列故事》的米希·哈蒙，

sentences.en: talking about the unforgettable, ramshackle, massive bus station known as the City Under a Roof.
sentences.zh: 在谈论那个被称为“屋檐下的城市”、令人难忘、破旧不堪且规模宏大的巴士站。

sentences.en: It's dirty and smelly and feels depressing, deserted.
sentences.zh: 它脏乱、恶臭，让人感到压抑和荒凉。

sentences.en: But at the same time, it's colorful and full of life.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，它又色彩斑斓，充满生机。

sentences.en: The station houses vendors, foreign workers, and refugees from all over the world.
sentences.zh: 车站里住着来自世界各地的商贩、外籍劳工和难民。

sentences.en: On the fourth floor, in what's called Manila Avenue,
sentences.zh: 在四楼，也就是所谓的“马尼拉大道”，

sentences.en: you can stuff yourself with homemade pan-fried lumpia that Filipino caregivers sell on their day off.
sentences.zh: 你可以大快朵颐地享用菲律宾护工在休息日售卖的自制煎春卷。

sentences.en: If you turn the corner, an old-timer might drag you into the Netzach David synagogue,
sentences.zh: 如果你转过街角，一位老住户可能会把你拉进内扎赫·大卫犹太会堂，

sentences.en: after which you can meander past tattoo parlors, churches, the free STD clinic,
sentences.zh: 之后你可以漫步经过纹身店、教堂、免费性病诊所，

sentences.en: Eritrean brides getting their hair braided, the Israeli-Filipino matchmaking agency,
sentences.zh: 正在编辫子的厄立特里亚新娘、以色列-菲律宾婚介所，

sentences.en: fringe theater spaces, and end up at a giant Yiddish book library.
sentences.zh: 边缘剧场空间，最后来到一家巨大的意第绪语书库。

sentences.en: For about 20 years, until the year 2010, Tel Aviv's new central bus station was the largest in the world.
sentences.zh: 大约20年间，直到2010年，特拉维夫新中央巴士站曾是世界上最大的巴士站。

sentences.en: This is in a city whose population just barely reached 400,000 people during this time.
sentences.zh: 这还是在一个当时人口刚刚达到40万的城市里。
这个巴士站让人头晕目眩。

sentences.en: In fact, it's almost impossible not to get lost there.
sentences.zh: 事实上，在那里不迷路几乎是不可能的。

sentences.en: All attempts at designing proper wayfinding have failed miserably.
sentences.zh: 所有设计合理导向系统的尝试都惨遭失败。

sentences.en: But what's probably most interesting about the new central bus station in Tel Aviv
sentences.zh: 但关于特拉维夫新中央巴士站最有趣的地方可能在于，

sentences.en: is that it's sort of a layered fossil of the history of Israel.
sentences.zh: 它就像是以色列历史的一层层化石。

sentences.en: If archaeologists were to excavate through the layers,
sentences.zh: 如果考古学家挖掘这些地层，

sentences.en: they'd find remnants of every phase in the short story of this state.
sentences.zh: 他们会发现这个国家短暂历史中每个阶段的遗迹。

sentences.en: From independence through post-war euphoria to recession and westernization,
sentences.zh: 从独立到战后的狂喜，再到衰退和西化，

sentences.en: they'd be able to trace the waves of immigration to Israel,
sentences.zh: 他们将能够追溯到以色列的移民浪潮，
来自欧洲和北非的移民。

sentences.en: So in many ways, the story of Tel Aviv's new central bus station is the story of Israel.
sentences.zh: 所以在很多方面，特拉维夫新中央巴士站的故事就是以色列的故事。

sentences.en: And this story of Israel, as told through this bus station,
sentences.zh: 而这个通过巴士站讲述的以色列故事，

sentences.en: is going to be told to us by Yochai Metal,
sentences.zh: 将由尤海·梅塔尔为我们讲述，

sentences.en: from the brilliant radio program Israel Story.
sentences.zh: 他来自出色的广播节目《以色列故事》。

sentences.en: There isn't a single thing I like about this station.
sentences.zh: 这个车站里没有一件我喜欢的东西。
这里的一切都毫无价值。

sentences.en: Believe me, I'm here because I have no other choice.
sentences.zh: 相信我，我在这里是因为我别无选择。

sentences.en: He bought a store in Tel Aviv's new central bus station in the early 90s,
sentences.zh: 他在90年代初买下了特拉维夫新中央巴士站的一家店面，
甚至在它开业之前就买了。

sentences.en: He dreamt of eventually passing it on to his children.
sentences.zh: 他梦想着最终能把它传给自己的孩子。

sentences.en: I bought it as an investment 20 years ago.
sentences.zh: 我20年前把它当作投资买了下来。

sentences.en: No matter what happens, I'm stuck.
sentences.zh: 无论发生什么，我都走不掉。

sentences.en: Paying taxes, utility bills, office fees.
sentences.zh: 要交税、付水电费、交物业费。

sentences.en: Ilan's store has been closed for years,
sentences.zh: 伊兰的店已经关门好几年了，

sentences.en: because no one hangs out anymore at the far end of the fourth floor,
sentences.zh: 因为再也没有人会在四楼的最远端闲逛了，

sentences.en: where a huge supermarket used to stand.
sentences.zh: 那里曾经有一家巨大的超市。

sentences.en: And Ilan is just one of hundreds of vendors
sentences.zh: 而伊兰只是数百名商贩中的一员，

sentences.en: who paid good money to purchase a store here,
sentences.zh: 他们当年花了大价钱在这里买下店面，

sentences.en: and who are today stuck with a property that's worth absolutely nothing.
sentences.zh: 而如今却被困在这一文不值的房产里。

sentences.en: I met Ilan in a section of the station called the Ramlod Market on the third floor.
sentences.zh: 我在三楼一个叫拉姆洛德市场的地方见到了伊兰。

sentences.en: He was moonlighting, selling baby clothes to Eritrean refugees at a friend's stall,
sentences.zh: 他在打零工，在朋友的摊位上向厄立特里亚难民兜售婴儿服装，

sentences.en: trying to make up for the lost income from his out-of-business shop.
sentences.zh: 试图弥补他倒闭店铺带来的收入损失。

sentences.en: Most of the stalls around him are abandoned.
sentences.zh: 他周围的大多数摊位都废弃了。

sentences.en: Old newspapers are glued to the display windows of nearby storefronts.
sentences.zh: 旧报纸被贴在附近店面的橱窗上。

sentences.en: If you come close, you can make out headlines about the 2003 Columbia space shuttle disaster,
sentences.zh: 如果你走近看，还能辨认出关于2003年哥伦比亚号航天飞机灾难的头条新闻，

sentences.en: or the disengagement from Gaza in 2005.
sentences.zh: 或是2005年从加沙撤离的新闻。

sentences.en: The ceilings are covered with black soot.
sentences.zh: 天花板上覆盖着黑色的煤烟。

sentences.en: Bored peddlers anxiously smoke cigarettes right underneath an old sign that says no smoking,
sentences.zh: 无聊的小贩们焦虑地在写着“禁止吸烟”的旧标志下抽着烟，

sentences.en: and the smell of nicotine blends into the stench of urine, sweat, and diesel fumes.
sentences.zh: 尼古丁的味道混杂在尿液、汗水和柴油废气的恶臭中。

sentences.zh: 和“中央车站”的商贩们待在一起真让人沮丧，

sentences.zh: 也就是特拉维夫的新中央巴士站。

sentences.en: The structure itself is terribly confusing, and that's no coincidence.
sentences.zh: 建筑本身极其令人困惑，这绝非巧合。

sentences.en: It was designed to make people get loSt.
sentences.zh: 它的设计初衷就是让人迷路。

sentences.en: The labyrinth, it was coined by the station's chief architect, Ram Karmi.
sentences.zh: “迷宫”，这是车站首席建筑师拉姆·卡尔米提出的概念。

sentences.en: And in a labyrinth, you get loSt.
sentences.zh: 而在迷宫里，你就会迷路。

sentences.en: You know how you get in, but you have no idea how you get out, or even if you get out.
sentences.zh: 你知道你是怎么进来的，但完全不知道怎么出去，甚至不知道能不能出去。

sentences.en: I'm an architect, and I'm the widow of Ram Karmi.
sentences.zh: 我是一名建筑师，也是拉姆·卡尔米的遗孀。

sentences.en: Ram always said that a good city is a city you get lost in.
sentences.zh: 拉姆总是说，一座好的城市就是一座你会迷失其中的城市。

sentences.en: And he imagined the central bus station as a city under a roof.
sentences.zh: 他把中央巴士站想象成屋檐下的城市。

sentences.en: So if it is a city under a roof, why shouldn't we get a little bit lost inside?
sentences.zh: 所以如果它是一座屋檐下的城市，为什么我们不能在里面稍微迷失一下呢？

sentences.en: So in order to help me get lost in an, I don't know, slightly more organized fashion,
sentences.zh: 为了帮我以一种，怎么说呢，稍微更有条理的方式迷路，

sentences.en: I teamed up with an energetic architectural duo.
sentences.zh: 我与一对充满活力的建筑师搭档合作。
我是一名来自以色列的建筑师。

sentences.en: I'm an Israeli architect as well.
sentences.zh: 我也是一名以色列建筑师。

sentences.en: And I'm currently a master's student at the Architectural Association in London.
sentences.zh: 我目前是伦敦建筑联盟学院的硕士生。

sentences.en: I just graduated from master's school of design in Harvard.
sentences.zh: 我刚从哈佛设计研究生院毕业。

sentences.zh: 我们也知道大家对这个车站的看法，以及这座建筑有多复杂。

sentences.zh: 但当我们看到这些图纸时，它们真的很美。

sentences.en: The drawings are indeed beautiful, with their sweeping lines and huge glass skylights.
sentences.zh: 这些图纸确实很美，有着流畅的线条和巨大的玻璃天窗。

sentences.en: But few people see much beauty in the building as it stands today.
sentences.zh: 但很少有人能从现在的建筑中看出多少美感。
塔莉亚和埃拉德是例外。

sentences.zh: 所以这里很暗，实际上是非常暗，而且空气不流通。

sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，它就像一个黑暗的游乐园。

I would say it's a multi-sensual place.

sentences.zh: 我环顾四周，意识到我们身处一家荒废电影院的大厅里。

sentences.zh: 我们现在实际上是在地下15米处，这里曾经是“大电影院”。

sentences.zh: 音响效果依然出色，红色天鹅绒座椅的垫子也相当舒适。

sentences.en: This forgotten glamour is testimony to the big hopes this station embodied in its early days.
sentences.zh: 这种被遗忘的魅力见证了该车站在早期所承载的巨大希望。

但这从未实现，电影院在开业仅几年后就关闭了。
